hypotheses.summary: Revision 5e07d73148d0a704b8fefe5f379bc652bb773655, deployed at 2026-11-12T00:26:56Z, rewrote average_spend_per_item in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py. It now re-sums the purchase list prefix on every loop iteration, so the work grows quadratically with purchase count. Account-page latency jumped from about 215 ms p95 to about 2,100 ms and p50 from 45 ms to 450 ms. Error rate, traffic, CPU and memory stayed flat.

supporting_evidence.claim: Rollout converged: all 3 replicas are running revision 5e07d73148d0a704b8fefe5f379bc652bb773655, deployed at 2026-11-12T00:26:56Z

Diff to spend_summary.py replaces `account.total_cents // len(account.purchases)` with a loop that recomputes `sum(earlier.price_cents for earlier in account.purchases[:index + 1])` on every iteration, which is O(n^2)
p95_ms rose from 219 at 00:25 to 336 at 00:26 and 2170 at 00:27, with p50 at 440 ms and p99 at 3680 ms; error_rate and request_volume stayed flat

Logs show only the pre-existing ClientDisconnected errors at about 1%, with no dependency errors or new failure types. The three replicas all started at 2026-11-11T12:31:56Z on V100 nodes, so there is no placement change.
